subject: Request: Documentation for wholesale tax exemption — billing audit
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@orionwholesale.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: Documentation for wholesale tax exemption — billing audit

Hi Dana,

Following up on our conversation on the call this morning — thanks again. We have two outstanding invoices for Orion Wholesale that may be eligible for wholesale tax treatment if we can obtain the appropriate resale documentation: INV-0042 (2026-08-15) and INV-0043 (2026-09-02).

To proceed, our finance team needs a signed resale/exemption certificate that includes:
- Buyer legal name (must match the invoice)
- State of issuance and buyer resale/registration number (where applicable)
- Signature and title of an authorized representative
- Effective date or blanket period (if this is a blanket certificate)

If you can attach the certificate (PDF) and, if available, a short authorization letter on company letterhead confirming Orion's reseller registration numbers, that will speed verification. If DocSign is easier we can route a quick envelope for signature.

I attached the invoices (redwood_invoices_Q3_Q4_2026.zip) for your reference — please reference INV-0042 / INV-0043 in your response so our team can match once we receive validated docs.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood-inference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@orionwholesale.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Documentation for wholesale tax exemption — billing audit

Sean —

Thanks for the clear note. I attached what our tax admin exported — "Orion_PA_resale_certificate_20261202.pdf" — and an internal authorization memo. Our procurement team believes that as a wholesale reseller we are exempt in PA and the certificate we provided is a blanket form used across our vendors.

Two quick notes:
- The attached certificate shows Orion's name and is on our standard form, but our state reseller number is in our corporate portal under a different ID (we can pull that if needed).
- We did not include Redwood's vendor ID on the form; is that required on your side?

Can you confirm whether this is sufficient or if you need the signature to be on a specific template? If you prefer, we can sign the vendor-specific template and return via DocuSign today.

Attaching: Orion_PA_resale_certificate_20261202.pdf; authorization_letter_orion.pdf

Best,
Dana Lopez
Director of Finance Operations

Karthik / Monica —

Forwarding the certificate Orion just sent. Quick summary:
- Customer says this is a blanket PA resale certificate; attached PDF is a standard form but appears to be missing a state reseller/registration number and does not reference Redwood as a vendor.
- They asked whether this is sufficient for us to reissue those two invoices as tax-exempt.

Action items I need from tax/finance:
1) Can we accept the attached PDF as-is for PA? If not, what exact field(s) are missing so I can ask the customer for the minimal changes?
2) If acceptable, please confirm the process for issuing credit memos: finance will need the validated certificate and a short authorization memo from the customer (they attached one labeled authorization_letter_orion.pdf).

I put the HubSpot company link in the thread for context: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Happy to route a DocuSign if that will be faster — Dana said they can sign vendor-specific templates today.

Thanks,
Sean

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>

Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:48:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Documentation for wholesale tax exemption — billing audit

Sean —

Thanks for the ping and for attaching the files. Reviewed the attached certificate and authorization memo. Short answer: the current PDF is close but incomplete for our internal acceptance and for audit purposes. Specifically:
- The PA blanket form provided lacks an explicit buyer "PA Sales Tax License / Registration" number (we need that to tie to a state registry).
- There is no statement on the form identifying Redwood Inference as the vendor/seller. Our policy requires that either the certificate include the seller name or be accompanied by an authorization letter that references the invoices to be credited and the seller name.

Minimal ask to avoid a prolonged cycle: please request Orion to either:
1) Sign our vendor-specific resale certificate template (I can attach) and include their PA registration number; OR
2) Return a corrected copy of their blanket certificate with the PA registration nubmer filled in and an explicit line that this exemption covers transactions with Redwood Inference, plus a short authorization letter on letterhead referencing INV-0042 and INV-0043.

I'll prepare the credit memos as soon as we get an acceptable document. Finance will issue credits for INV-0042 and INV-0043 and note them against DL-2026-ORION-77 once we have verified the signature and registration number.

To speed this along, here's a DocuSign link you can send to the customer that pre-populates our vendor template: https://www.docusign.com/verify/abc123-orion-resale

Attaching a blank vendor template and a short sample authorization note (authorization_letter_orion.pdf is fine but the registration number still needs to be populated).

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations & Tax Compliance
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com | +1 650-555-2034
